source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
While this model leads a unit, it may use this ability whenever you select that unit to shoot in your Shooting phase or to fight in the Fight phase.

If it does, pick 1 of that unit's Bodyguard models to be destroyed. For the rest of the phase, this model's Psychic weapons get +D3 Attacks and +D3 Strength.
